d: Airline chaos. Bank disruptions. Government agency breaches. As America enters the busy holiday travel season, former CIA officer Andy Bustamante investigates this growing wave of outages and asks the terrifying question: are we already under attack? Even if recent outages weren’t coordinated, they exposed how dependent we are on technology that may be far more fragile and outdated than we think. Andrew Bustamante talks with Richie “4nu81x” Vinson, a former malicious hacker turned ethical hacker who has worked protecting critical nuclear assets. He’s also joined by Jamieson O’Reilly who…
